_comment: The ONE grammar of ledger fields, read by every reader in Python (scripts/ledger_fields.py) and JavaScript (helpers/ledger-fields.cjs). A field stands at a line start (after list marks, `>`, `*`, a backtick) or inside an entry line after a field bar or whitespace (`... | id: x | class: todo`). Before 2026-11-10 four readers of `id:` used four patterns (brain-scan-prep, instrument-watch, shared-reach-check, autonomous-idle-gate); one still read line starts only (content review of agent-brain #475).

_cases.text: - [ ] do X | id: x-1 | class: todo
